_comment: Task 9 (2026-07-28): the preregistered development matrix for the A1-A4
Graph Nexus candidates. These five windows are DEVELOPMENT/REGRESSION
evidence only -- production eligibility still requires the repository's
`matrix` must be filled in with a complete ExperimentMatrixManifest
document (one ExperimentSpec per arm per cost scenario) and published via
POST /backtest-evidence/matrices BEFORE the first backtest of this matrix
is queued. The runner refuses to start without it, because a manifest
written after the first result could have its arms reworded to fit.
Gate rules, fixed here so they cannot be renegotiated later:
- bull and rally must EACH beat SPY after costs (median alpha >= +1pp,
positive 90% lower bound from the fixture/session bootstrap)
- bear, flip and full may degrade by at most 0.5pp median / 1pp worst
- max drawdown may degrade by at most 0.5pp median / 1pp worst
- results must survive the 25bps and 50bps one-way cost stress
- alpha must stay positive after removing the largest winning stock
- any failed, stopped or missing arm is a gate FAILURE
